About the Studio

Interiors built around how a family actually lives

HFhomes is an interior design studio dedicated to creating spaces that feel considered, comfortable and distinctly personal. We work closely with every client to understand their taste, their routines and their home, then translate that into interiors that are as functional as they are beautiful.

Over six years, we've designed and executed living rooms, bedrooms and full homes — carrying every detail from false ceilings and lighting to drapery, upholstery and furniture through to a finished, lived-in space. Our style leans classic and layered: rich textures, warm metallics and craftsmanship that ages well.

6+Years of Experience
100%Bespoke Approach
What We Offer

Services for residential and commercial spaces, tailored to how far you want us involved

01

Full Home & Commercial Interiors

End-to-end design and execution for entire homes and commercial spaces — layout, materials, furniture and finishing, managed from concept to handover.

02

Living & Lounge Design

Statement seating, feature walls, false ceilings and lighting schemes designed to anchor the rooms you entertain and unwind in.

03

Bedroom Design

Tailored headboards, upholstered panelling, drapery and ambient lighting for bedrooms that feel calm, warm and personal.

04

False Ceiling & Lighting

Gypsum and POP ceiling detailing with layered LED lighting, designed to add depth and character to every room.

05

Curtains & Soft Furnishings

Custom drapery, upholstery and cushioning in fabrics and finishes chosen to complement your palette.

06

Furniture Selection & Styling

Bespoke and curated furniture pieces, sourced or crafted, then styled to complete the room.
